summary: A C64 SID player and synth for the FM-1, started as a feasibility study: it plays .sid tunes and GoatTracker 2 songs through reSID 0.16, includes a GoatTracker editor on the device, and runs as a module or firmware on fm1-dock.
features: Plays PSID and RSID tunes, RSID on a full emulated C64
GoatTracker 2 songs and an on-device editor; 16 flash song slots
SID synth with 12 instruments and a three-track, 16-step sequencer
Choice of reSID 0.16 or its own SID model, 6581 or 8580
Chorus, delay and reverb; USB MIDI notes and program change
Needs fm1-dock on hardware; no USB audio, MIDI out or TRS MIDI yet
